fields.label: How It Works
fields.options:
1. Each record of the DocType below can have its own folder in SharePoint, named by Folder Name Pattern. With Folder Creation set to Automatic it is created on the record's first attachment; with On demand, only when someone asks: on the record, use SharePoint › Create folder in the toolbar or Create folder now in the Files in Microsoft 365 panel at the top of the form; or add a SharePoint Folder.
  2. Files attached to a record that has a folder (sidebar attachments, not image or Attach fields) are moved into it in the background a few seconds later. They keep opening from the record, through the ERP's own permissions.
  3. Files people save into the folder from Teams or SharePoint show in the record's Files in Microsoft 365 panel, at the top of its form.
  4. Nothing is deleted from SharePoint unless Microsoft Settings says so, and then only to the site recycle bin.

Setting up: paste the site URL (for a Teams channel: Files tab › Open in SharePoint), save, click Site Grant Script and have a SharePoint admin run it, then click Test. Standard channel: keep Group record folders in a base folder on and use the channel name as Base Folder. Private or shared channel: use the channel's own site and untick it, so record folders sit directly in the channel.

fields.description: Attachments on records of this DocType are stored in SharePoint. One mapping per DocType.
fields.label: DocType

fields.description:
Automatic: every record gets a folder on its first attachment, and all its attachments move to SharePoint.
On demand: nothing moves until someone creates the record's folder (SharePoint › Create folder in the record's toolbar, or Add Row in Folders below). From then on that record's attachments move; other records stay on this server.
fields.label: Folder Creation

fields.description: The site that owns the library, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Sales. For a Microsoft Teams team, open the channel's Files tab and choose Open in SharePoint.
fields.label: SharePoint Site URL

fields.description: The library's display name. Teams channel files live in Documents (shown in SharePoint as Shared Documents).
fields.label: Document Library

fields.description:
On: record folders go inside the Base Folder below. Use this for a standard Teams channel, with the channel name as Base Folder.
Off: record folders go straight into the library. Use this for a private or shared channel, which has a site of its own, so they appear directly in the channel's Files tab.
fields.label: Group record folders in a base folder

fields.description: Path inside the library, created if missing. For a standard Teams channel this is the channel name, e.g. Projects. Nested paths like Projects/2026 work.
fields.label: Base Folder

fields.description: One folder per record, named from its fields: {name}, {title}, or any {fieldname}, e.g. {name} - {customer}. Characters SharePoint does not allow are replaced.
fields.label: Folder Name Pattern
Options
fields.description: Each option follows SharePoint Settings unless set here for this DocType.

fields.label: Keep a local copy after upload
fields.description:
Default: as in SharePoint Settings.
On: this DocType's files keep their copy on this server too, e.g. while trialling it.
Off: the copy on this server is deleted once the file is in SharePoint.

fields.label: Remove from SharePoint when the attachment is deleted
fields.description:
Default: as in SharePoint Settings.
On: deleting one of this DocType's attachments sends its SharePoint copy to the site's recycle bin.
Off: the SharePoint copy is always kept, e.g. for records that must be retained.

fields.label: Folders
fields.description: One row per record that has a SharePoint folder. The app adds rows as records get their folder. Add Row to give a record one by hand: pick the record and Save; the folder is created where this mapping says, or linked if you paste one in Existing Folder. Delete removes only the link: the folder and its files stay in SharePoint.
Looked up from the URL on first use. Cleared whenever the URL or library changes.
fields.label: Site ID

fields.description:
Who may click Create folder on a record that has no folder yet. They must also be able to edit the record.
Empty: System Managers only.
Roles listed: System Managers, plus users with any of these roles.
fields.label: Who can create folders
